rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem points toward merchandise, statement credit, deposit to qualifying U.S. Bank account, gift cards and travel, or redeem instantly with Real-Time Rewards. Points do not expire as long as account remains active. Can transfer points between business and personal Altitude cards.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 75,000 bonus points after you make eligible Net Purchases totaling $6,000 or more on the account owner's card within 180 days of account opening.

benefits.title: $25 statement credit for taxi or rideshare
benefits.description: Receive a $25 statement credit after three consecutive monthly taxi or rideshare transactions paid for with your card.

benefits.title: Priority Pass™ Digital airport lounge access
benefits.description: Priority Pass™ Digital annual membership with access to more than 1,800 VIP lounges worldwide, plus four complimentary visits per membership year.

benefits.title: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.description: Enjoy no foreign transaction fees when making purchases outside the United States.

benefits.title: U.S. Bank Spend Management
benefits.description: Take control of your card spend with U.S. Bank Spend Management – a game-changing platform for monitoring and managing business expenses.

benefits.title: Transfer points with personal card
benefits.description: Transfer points between your business and personal Altitude cards so you can redeem points sooner. Works with personal U.S. Bank Altitude® Go or Altitude® Connect card.

benefits.title: Pay over time with U.S. Bank ExtendPay® Plan
benefits.description: Receive a new cardmember $0 fee offer on ExtendPay Plans opened in the first 60 days after account opening. Not all accounts are eligible for ExtendPay Plans.

benefits.title: Auto rental collision damage waiver
benefits.description: Auto rental collision damage waiver included.

benefits.title: Real-Time Rewards
benefits.description: Business Altitude Connect Card is eligible for Real Time Rewards, enabling you to instantly turn your business purchases into rewards from your mobile device.
